========================================================================================================================
8. INTERPRETATION / WHAT THIS REPORT CAN AND CANNOT PROVE
========================================================================================================================
- A seamless run loop should have a reasonably matching start/end pose, unless the Action intentionally contains a transition.
- Start/end bone differences are numerical seam indicators; compare the exact frame convention used by Unity/FBX export (some loops omit the duplicated final frame).
- Quaternion shortest-arc angular deltas reduce false 360-degree spikes caused by Euler angle wrapping.
- Floor offsets are estimates from rig bone endpoints; inspect the actual shoe/foot mesh against the ground plane to confirm contact.
- Numerical analysis cannot prove good-looking silhouettes, mesh intersections, weight-paint quality, or whether the run feels natural.
- For visual review, inspect frames around the highest head speeds, highest joint angular changes, and loop seam listed above.
